title: Each FlowWeb webhook caps the body it reads before checking the signature

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: all five FlowWeb hooks verify an HMAC-SHA256 signature with a timing-safe compare and a 5-minute window (lib/flowweb/claim.ts). flowweb-crm, flowweb-link and flowweb-outcomes read the whole body with req.text() before any size check; only flowweb-claim enforces its 64 KB cap (SEC-030). There is no nonce, so a signed request can be replayed inside 5 minutes. Fix: the same byte cap on the other three; a replay nonce when FlowWeb can send one.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
